text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan seemed quite pleased upon 
hearing rumors from the stands praising 
her cute running style. It looked like it 
had given her a boost in confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her unique pitch running style serves as a 
formidable weapon in races. With momentum 
on her side, Aston Machan headed toward 
the paddock alone once again today.
